*Welcome to save rabbit rescue ]! 🐰*

We're a passionate team dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and rehoming rabbits in need. From abandoned bunnies to those rescued from neglect, we provide love, care, and a second chance at a happy life.

*Join us on our mission to make a difference, one hop at a time! 😊*

- Updates on our current rescues and adoptables
- Tips on rabbit care and health
- Heartwarming adoption stories and successes
- And behind-the-scenes peeks at life at the rescue

*Subscribe for adorable bunny videos and updates on how you can help! 🐾*
